errors: The breaking change is not the first section; a summary sentence comes before it, though it also mentions apiKey first.
"Requests that fail will now retry up to two more times" is an inference; the default goes from 3 to 5 retries, which is two more than before. This is correct but slightly loose wording.
"Long-running apps that reconnect often will now use stable memory" overstates the fix. The input only says a leak was fixed, not that memory is stable.
"If you do not pass it, init() will not work" is vague. It does not say whether init() throws, returns an error, or fails silently.
The example for on('error') is shown as a bare on() call, with an assumption note on handler arguments. This is flagged honestly but adds uncertainty.
